verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents bulk user imports and exports for database connections, and offers a CLI and MCP server for automating multi-step tenant operations. The evidence only covers bulk user import/export for migration, not general bulk operations across many items. missing for 10: bulk update/delete or bulk role/organization assignment across many items, evidence that the CLI or MCP server performs batch operations, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
